mapper.sql: select m.id, m.user_id, m.area, m.category, m.demand_type, m.scale, m.expert_field, m.bank_loan_type, m.match_score, m.match_user_id, m.match_user_name, m.create_time, m.update_time, u.user_name, u.user_type, u.status from sys_user_match m left join sys_user u on m.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_match (user_id, area, category, demand_type, scale, expert_field, bank_loan_type, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{area}, #{category}, #{demandType}, #{scale}, #{expertField}, #{bankLoanType}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update sys_user_match set area = #{area}, category = #{category}, demand_type = #{demandType}, scale = #{scale}, expert_field = #{expertField}, bank_loan_type = #{bankLoanType}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
